ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Mars

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Keep a coin in a special place as a symbol of your prosperity.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Take five minutes when you wake up to decide how you want to feel today.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Say no to a commitment that wears you out.
